profile.headline: Gaming Enthusiast
profile.summary: Helping a team of engineers create great games is my thing. I am not taking employment offers at this time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My top priority is providing technical expertise at Tic Toc Games to efficiently create high quality games. This includes vetting and hiring programmers, creating technical processes, estimating scope of work for contracts, problem solving difficult technical problems, and encouraging a culture of quality in our codebases.

positions.title: Owner, Deckhand, Fisherman
positions.description: The fishing vessel Early Times was crewed by myself and two other people. Over the course of five summers, we caught and sold almost 800,000 pounds of wild Alaska salmon.

positions.title: Mathematics Student
positions.description: Studying mathematics at UC Berkeley gave me the chance to sit down and see how hard I can work my brain. I loved studying mathematics. The rigorous logic required to write proofs has really helped when picking apart and writing complex program code.

positions.title: Mathematics and Physics Tutor
positions.description: I tutored calculus, geometry, trigonometry, and algebra. For physics, I tutored Intro to Physics and calculus based kinematics. Sometimes I would be assigned to a math class and hold weekly study groups. Most times I hung out in the tutoring center and helped the many students that walked in with a large variety of questions.

positions.title: Call Center Lead
positions.description: At Arvato Services, I was a customer service representative for the Microsoft Partner Program. By the end of my time at Arvato, I had moved up to be a call center lead and had represented Microsoft in person at the Microsoft Worldwide Parter Conference in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

projects.title: Funko Pop! Blitz
projects.description:
Match 3 to bring Funko Pop! figures to life!

Collect and play with iconic characters in a brand new matching puzzle game that celebrates the fan in all of us!

Collect in-game Pop!s from your favorite fandoms like Back to the Future, Jurassic Park, Shrek, How to Train Your Dragon, Universal Monsters, and Fantastik Plastik – just to name a few! Chase high scores and unlock prizes with your favorite in-game Pop! characters: Marty McFly, Blue from Jurassic World, Tigress, Dracula, and many more. See them all come to life with emotions, fun animations, and powerful Supers.

projects.title: Smurfs Bubble Story
projects.description:
Ready, aim — pop! Embark on a colorful, bubble shooting adventure with all your favorite Smurfs in Smurfs Bubble Shooter Story! Travel with Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Clumsy and rest of the Smurfs family, on a quest across a forbidden forest, mysterious meadows and rushing rivers to pick up other Smurfs.

Millions of downloads on iOS and Android!
